combinationRules: Use worst-case bounded sum when only deterministic bounds exist or dependence is unknown.
Use root-sum-square only with evidence of independence, zero-mean behavior, compatible distributions, and a common domain.
Use covariance, joint sensitivity, or a conservative grouped bound for correlated or systematic terms.
Preserve asymmetric bounds where effects are directional or nonlinear.
Transform terms into the quantity at the tested boundary before combination.
Do not aggregate unrelated fixtures merely because their units are angular.
Any required UNBOUNDED_UNRESOLVED term leaves the combined scientific budget UNBOUNDED_UNRESOLVED.

metricHierarchy.singularityRule: RA residual alone is ill-conditioned near celestial poles.
UT1-UTC, xp, yp, dX, and dY remain separate.
Azimuth is undefined at zenith and nadir and ill-conditioned nearby.
Near-horizon rules must be model, atmosphere, observer, and domain dependent.
Pole and longitude-normalization cases require explicit semantics.
Scene metrics cannot redefine astronomy acceptance.
Educational validity is separate from astronomy error.
